prompt: Give me a 14 days travel to Dublin
response: Day 1-3: Explore Dublin city center, visit landmarks like Trinity College and the Guinness Storehouse. Day 4-6: Take day trips to nearby towns like Kilkenny and Galway. Day 7-9: Spend a few days on the coast, visiting places like Howth and Bray. Day 10-12: Go on a countryside tour to see the rural beauty of Ireland. Day 13-14: Return to Dublin and enjoy some free time for shopping or additional sightseeing.
